description: This file contains the implementation of the NoteService interface, providing CRUD operations and sample data seeding for Note entities. It uses Spring annotations for service declaration and transaction management, and interacts with NoteRepository for persistence.

classes.name: NoteServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the NoteService interface providing CRUD and batch sample data operations for Note entities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Note entity from the provided request and saves it via the repository.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Note identified by id with data from the request.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Note by its id, throws NotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all Note entities.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a Note by id if it exists, throws NotFoundException otherwise.

methods.name: seedSampleData
methods.description: Creates and persists a specified number of sample Note entities.
